notes.title: STORE AND STORAGE WORKERS
notes.content:
Hello dear players!
Here comes the brand-new Store and Storage Workers!

Now, your ordered items will be carried to the warehouse and placed on the shelves by workers—so you can focus more on building your collection!

🔧 Update Notes:
Added 4 Store Workers

Added 4 Storage Workers

Warehouse is now available

Warehouse shelves can be purchased
The warehouse shelves can only be used for product boxes.

After reaching level 30, you can automatically open all your boxes by simply pressing the T key!

As we approach the full release, there are just a few updates and bug fixes left.
However, we still haven’t been able to consistently reproduce the Skill Card usability bug.
If any player can consistently trigger this bug, please let us know in which situations it occurs. Your help is highly appreciated!

The delay in this update was due to our decision to release both Store and Storage Workers together.
Instead of splitting them into separate updates, we wanted to deliver them as one complete package.
Thank you for your patience and support! ❤️


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/ddc9e62900d828b45f739e49b0d12422d936b4c3.gif[/img]

have fun!

notes.title: REGULAR UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello dear players,
I'm here with a regular update before the next big patch!

I noticed many of you were unhappy with the vending machine area and its pricing. This update includes some adjustments to address that.

Here are the update notes:

3 new challenging and luck-based achievements have been added.

Vending machine probabilities have been rebalanced, and the vending machine price has been updated to $25.

Twitch integration has been added to the game.

A bug where shield and rocket skills caused slowdown effects during NPC races has been fixed.

There was also an issue where cars wouldn't be awarded at the end of races. We made some adjustments to address this, but honestly, we're not entirely sure if the issue is completely resolved, as we haven't been able to reproduce it.
Please let us know if you still encounter this problem.

And finally, a small hint for the future:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/c327d77617a1e259f2ddd622ff1eb2f964701967.png[/img]


have fun!

notes.title: BUG FIX
notes.content:
Hello dear players,
Before our next major update, we're releasing a small bug fix patch.
Here are the patch notes:

Fixed an issue where skills behaved incorrectly in NPC races.

Resolved a bug where skill cards were dropping from the wrong packs (Series 1 cards were appearing in Series 2 packs).

Fixed an outline issue on Race Track 02.

Skills no longer travel endlessly until they hit an opponent; they now disappear based on their level, so timing will be more important.

Fixed some rare bugs related to the customer system.

notes.title: BUNDLE TABLE
notes.content:
Hello dear players!
We’ve finally addressed an issue that the community has been talking about for a long time: extra cars in your collection!
Now you can easily solve this with the new Bundle Table – purchase it, bundle your extra cars, and sell them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/0fbed44fcaf185b0abb30ca751eef3a3c36a9c0d.gif[/img]

Bundle Table has been added to the game. You can now package and sell extra cars from your collection.

Fixed the issue where customers were not evenly distributed across cash registers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/1d3de494e308daf2916eae6fa8a947710d5ffa6b.png[/img]

Economy balance adjustments.

Fixed several issues related to the car collection.

Fixed bugs during product scanning at the checkout.

Launch-exclusive cars will no longer appear in the Faster series and can now be found under the "Souvenirs" section in your collection. These cars can now only be obtained through NPC races.

In races, only one of each skill card can now be selected.

Added 3 new sellable products.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/d7a8cee0e26cfdc18a0d470f993db780f3ef488e.png[/img]

Cars affected by skills can no longer use other skills.

Time-rewind skill power has been reduced.

Drop rate of Tier 3 skill cards has been lowered.

The bug of every car display a speed of 100 has been fixed

Fixed an issue where particle effects would get stuck at the end of races.

Fixed text overflow issues in the end-of-day report.

notes.title: CASHIER UPDATE
notes.content:
Cashiers can now be hired!
While you focus on building your car collection and racing, let your employees handle the registers for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/f18096688a72142778f192000ace1c291e5b953b.gif[/img]

Hello dear players!
We saw how much you wanted a cashier update, so we worked hard to bring it forward sooner than planned.

We’ve also included many of the community’s suggestions in this update. Here are the patch notes:

Day duration has been extended.

Product profitability has been increased.

The game keeps running while it's in the background (alt-tabbed).

Fixed a bug where customers would constantly bend over when picking up products.

Store upgrade levels have been reduced.

Fixed various screen resolution issues.

Rival NPC car speeds are now hidden, making races more thrilling and risky.

After level 5, you can now skip the animation when opening car packs.

Skill card pack opening speed has been increased.

The "My Collection" app now shows how many cars you own out of the total in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/3c9b44783378ddf33a90bd3a5cfb725e7f213575.png[/img]

I also want to give you a little sneak peek about some future updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/5e94f3b733325f7b8ec144435fda39d2ed1ad438.png[/img]

:D have fun!

notes.title: 🚨THE WAIT IS ALMOST OVER – 7 DAYS TO GO!🔥
notes.content:
[h1]Supercar Collection Simulator launches into Early Access on April 14th![/h1]

Since the Prologue, thousands of players have stepped into the world of high-end car collecting – building dream garages, chasing rare models, and becoming true legends of the showroom. But that… was just the beginning.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3453600/Supercar_Collection_Simulator/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/3f9319225eba38ecfb11b9efbc5816801ce2f185.png[/img][/url]

Now, it's time for something bigger, bolder, and packed with action. Here's what's waiting for you in Early Access:

[b][h2]🚨 What's New in Early Access?[/h2][/b]

[h3][b]🏁 Race Your Customers[/b][/h3]
Not just a car collector anymore – now you're a racer too.
Customers will challenge you at Race Tables, and if you win... their car is yours. High stakes. High reward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/7a074706b383ad4cfcd176a097688749be801b60.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🃏 Skill Card Packs Are Here[/b][/h3]
Build your strategy with collectible Skill Cards.
Buy packs, unlock powerful abilities, and use them during races to gain an edge. Every card you pull could change the outcome of your next race.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/a4180f1b5ecf807faeb8f87f22598ce584894029.gif[/img]

[h3][b]♻️ Multiplayer Trade Battles[/b][/h3]
Go head-to-head in real-time car trading duels with your Steam friends.
Put your collection on the line and win your rival’s most prized cars!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/c53a5f73445b7f70e21a740373ee3b33f55e56b0.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🚗 More Cars, More Series[/b][/h3]
New brands. New models. New limited-edition collections.
Your garage is about to get a lot more crowded. If you already have exclusive cars from Prologue, you are the lucky one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/2ccb74485a6d3027543e37a2185417d6bfe5f2ee.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🪑 New Shelves, Tracks & Items[/b][/h3]
Redesign your showroom with new shelf types, mini racetracks, and decorative items. Your store deserves the upgrade. Not just cars – now you can stock and sell launchers, vehicle parts, and exclusive accessories.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/93d60dfe44583d0540ef5bc7f4a47d62dddfde42.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🪧 Name Your Store[/b][/h3]
That’s right – your brand, your rules. Give your shop a custom name and make it known in the collector’s world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/c492da26a0edd3707c2197dd97130b2aa482ae46.gif[/img]

[h3][b]📸 Enhanced Photo Mode[/b][/h3]
Improved tools, lighting, and camera angles help you create the perfect shots of your prized supercars.
Share your setups with the community and show off your style.

With your feedback from the Prologue, we've already implemented tons of improvements. And now, we want you in the garage with us as we shift gears toward full release.

[i][b]Early Access means you’ll be the first to test new features, collections, and game modes – and your ideas will help steer the roadmap ahead.[/b][/i]

[i]📅 Mark the Date – April 14,[/i] only 7 days to go until your real collector journey begins.

[url=https://discord.gg/kikigames][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/58bd0d5ff8eb0ccd34e2c2479845ceedb159c8e8.png[/img][/url]

Let’s make this launch unforgettable.
See you at the shop. 🚘💨
